profile.description: Priya runs a three-year-old online shop selling handmade silk-thread jewellery and decor to buyers in India and abroad, paid through PayPal. Demand is steady and growing.
profile.income_note: Monthly drawings from the business (~its monthly profit); no other income.

scenario.headline: Festive-season inventory financing
scenario.loan_purpose: Buy silk thread, packaging and gold-plated findings ahead of Diwali and Christmas orders
scenario.narrative: Priya expects festive orders to rise sharply but must pay suppliers up front. She wants a short working-capital loan repaid from the following months' sales. Her revenue is stable with few refunds, making her a strong, steady-income case.
